TodoTask.title: TodoTask
TodoTask.description: Represents a personal todo task owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this task.

title.description: Title of the task (1 to 200 characters).

notes.description: Additional details or notes for the task (0 to 1000 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task has been completed.

dueDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds for due date, or 0 if no due date is set.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing personal todo tasks.
